vulnerability.explanation: In the 16-bit path of the sBIT handling, the loop uses b = (bpp >> 4) down to 1, but indexes sig_bits[b] and writes to sig_bits[2*b+1] and sig_bits[2*b]. For RGBA16 (comps=4), this reads sig_bits[4] (OOB) and writes sig_bits[9] and sig_bits[8] (OOB) into an 8-byte array. This leads to out-of-bounds read and stack-based buffer overflow when bit_depth == 16 and color_type has multiple components.
